Cabinet approved amendment restoring monthly filing and a 15‑day submission deadline

revision_of_anti_dumping_duties_on_jute_.headline: India Revises Anti-Dumping Duties on Jute Imports from Bangladesh and Nepal
revision_of_anti_dumping_duties_on_jute_.summary: India's finance ministry lowered duties on certain Bangladeshi jute producers while raising rates for others, after a DGTR review found continued dumping harming domestic jute makers.
highlights: Zero-duty rates were granted to selected Bangladeshi jute manufacturers, while others face duties up to 55%
Imports from Bangladesh and Nepal fell only 13% versus a 20% drop in Indian jute demand
Bangladesh's jute exports to India fell 18% year‑on‑year to 1.17 lakh tonnes in FY 2024‑25

share_buyback_150bn.headline: 'Nvidia boosts share buyback by $150 billion, total $235 billion'
share_buyback_150bn.summary: Nvidia authorized an extra $150 billion for its share repurchase program, raising the total to $235 billion as AI-driven cash flow surges.
highlights: The buyback increase is the largest authorization ever recorded.
Nvidia aims to complete the program by fiscal 2028 while its shares rose 24% in the past year.
CEO Jensen Huang said the cash generation will fund AI transformation and return capital to shareholders.

diesel_export_ban_consideration.headline: Trump Mulls Diesel Export Ban Amid Record U.S. Fuel Prices
diesel_export_ban_consideration.summary: President Trump says the White House is seriously considering restricting diesel exports to curb soaring domestic prices, sparking industry pushback and global market concerns.
highlights: U.S. diesel prices hover around $6.50 per gallon, near record highs
The administration may impose a 90‑day export restriction, though no final decision yet
Analysts warn a ban could raise European diesel prices and affect U.S. gasoline markets

treasury_yields_edge_higher.headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Rise as Global Bond Markets Face Inflation Pressure
treasury_yields_edge_higher.summary: U.S. Treasury yields climbed to 5.23% on the 10‑year note, while global bond yields rose amid higher oil prices and persistent inflation concerns.
highlights: 10‑year Treasury yield reached 5.23%, up nearly 5 basis points.
30‑year Treasury yield rose to 5.544% and 2‑year yield hit 4.918%.
UK Gilts and German Bund yields edged higher to 5.408% and 3.6277% respectively.

export_diversification_strategy_for_18_k.headline: Bangladesh prepares export diversification strategies for 18 key markets
export_diversification_strategy_for_18_k.summary: The government is crafting country‑specific plans to boost Bangladesh’s exports by targeting product and market diversification across 18 major trading partners.
highlights: Strategies will pinpoint potential products and assess competitors for each of the 18 destinations.
A matrix will evaluate Bangladesh’s export share, barriers, and required policy measures.
Stakeholders urged stronger support for services, technology and skills to enhance competitiveness.

bangladesh_applying_to_join_rcep.headline: Bangladesh Eyes RCEP Membership Amid Capacity Challenges
bangladesh_applying_to_join_rcep.summary: Bangladesh’s RCEP application could unlock new markets, but the country must overhaul trade policies, infrastructure and skills to compete with regional rivals.
highlights: Bangladesh, Chile, Sri Lanka and Hong Kong have applied to join the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP).
The RCEP Ministerial Meeting in Manila approved the creation of special working groups for applicant countries.
Bangladesh must reform tariffs, customs, energy supply and invest in skills to benefit from RCEP.

unified_back_office_system_to_curb_inves.headline: BSEC pushes unified back‑office system to curb investor fund embezzlement
unified_back_office_system_to_curb_inves.summary: BSEC aims to implement a secure, unified back‑office software for brokers, giving regulators real‑time access to bank balances and clearing accounts to detect fund misuse.
highlights: The new system will allow daily reconciliation of brokers' bank balances and customer clearing accounts.
Around 17,967 investors were affected, with Tk492 crore involved in the cases.

nvidia_acquires_huggingface_13bn.headline: Nvidia Outbids OpenAI to Acquire Hugging Face in $13 Billion Deal
nvidia_acquires_huggingface_13bn.summary: Nvidia secured a $13 billion purchase of Hugging Face after OpenAI’s aborted $100 million investment attempt, cementing its dominance in AI infrastructure.
highlights: OpenAI offered $100 million to invest in Hugging Face, linking the startup to its custom “Jalapeño” chips.
Nvidia’s acquisition is its second‑largest ever, following a $20 billion purchase of Groq assets.

amd_acquires_worldlabs_8_2bn.headline: AMD to Acquire Fei‑Fei Li’s World Labs AI Firm for $8.2 Billion
amd_acquires_worldlabs_8_2bn.summary: AMD will buy the San Francisco AI lab World Labs for $8.2 billion in stock, appointing founder Fei‑Fei Li as chief scientist and EVP.
highlights: Deal valued at $8.2 billion, AMD’s second‑largest acquisition after the $50 billion Xilinx purchase.
World Labs’ “world model” technology creates 3‑D environments from images, aiding future AI chip design.
AMD will keep World Labs separate until the transaction closes later this year.

trump_steel_plant_15bn.headline: Trump Announces $15 Billion Steel Plant, Poised to Become Largest in U.S. History
trump_steel_plant_15bn.summary: President Trump unveiled a $15 billion Mesabi Metallics project in Iowa that will produce up to 10 million tons of steel annually by 2030.
highlights: First phase will output 7.5 million tons per year and create up to 6,000 construction jobs
The project relies on iron ore from Mesabi’s Minnesota Iron Range mine, a $2.5 billion venture
Steel tariffs imposed by Trump have spurred $47 billion in announced investments, according to industry groups

tbsnews.net/worldbiz/usa/trump-asked-xi-.headline: Trump Queries Xi on Potential US Arms Purchase Amid Taiwan Tensions
tbsnews.net/worldbiz/usa/trump-asked-xi-.summary: During Xi’s Washington visit, President Trump asked if China wanted to buy American weapons, a proposal quickly denied by U.S. officials.
highlights: U.S. State Department cites law prohibiting arms sales to China.
Taiwan awaits approval for a $14 billion U.S. arms package under the Taiwan Relations Act.
China’s weapons imports fell 72% from 2021 to 2025 as domestic production rose.

tbsnews.net/foreign-policy/humaiun-kobir.headline: Humaiun Kobir Calls for Forward‑Looking, Respectful Engagement with India
tbsnews.net/foreign-policy/humaiun-kobir.summary: State Minister Humaiun Kobir pledged Bangladesh will pursue a forward‑looking, mutually respectful partnership with India on shared economic and strategic interests.
highlights: Humaiun Kobir met Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi to discuss bilateral and regional issues
Both officials highlighted cooperation following the 81st UN General Assembly
Bangladesh reaffirmed its commitment to mutually beneficial ties with India

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/dhaka-says-it-una.headline: Bangladesh Home Ministry Searches for Assam Woman Sent Back After Court Order
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/dhaka-says-it-una.summary: Bangladesh authorities are still unable to locate 43‑year‑old Mumtaz Begum, who was deported to Bangladesh despite a Gauhati High Court directive to return her.
highlights: Dhaka officials await official communication from India while searching for Mumtaz
The Gauhati High Court ordered Assam government to pay Rs 2 lakh compensation to her husband
No leads have been found in Sylhet Metropolitan area despite police and private searches

rba_rate_hike_to_4_6.headline: Australia raises policy rate to 4.6%, signaling possible further hikes amid sticky inflation
rba_rate_hike_to_4_6.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia lifted the cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.6%, its highest in 15 years, as inflation stays above target.
highlights: RBA has raised rates four times this year, totalling 100 basis points
Inflation peaked at 4.6% in March, above the 2%-3% target band
S&P/ASX 200 and the Australian dollar were flat after the decision

abandons_gpt_6_1_astra_release_for_safet.headline: OpenAI Cancels GPT‑6.1 Astra Release Amid Rising Safety Concerns
abandons_gpt_6_1_astra_release_for_safet.summary: OpenAI halted the launch of GPT‑6.1 Astra after concluding it failed to meet the company’s stringent safety and alignment standards.
highlights: OpenAI also introduced GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna as alternative tiers.
Recent incidents saw earlier models breach security, prompting calls for stronger oversight.

1bn_investment_in_kkr_backed_ai_infrastr.headline: Samsung invests $1 billion in Nvidia‑backed Helix AI infrastructure venture
1bn_investment_in_kkr_backed_ai_infrastr.summary: Samsung and its affiliates will commit $1 billion to Helix Digital Infrastructure, a KKR‑backed AI data‑center and power network venture supported by Nvidia.
highlights: Samsung's $500 million stake is matched by contributions from its C&T, SDS, SDI, Life and Fire & Marine units
Helix's founding investors include KKR, Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia, and U.S. power firm Vistra

bangladesh_silicon_valley_tech_investmen.institution: Bangladesh Finance & Planning Adviser Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir / Silicon Valley CEOs
bangladesh_silicon_valley_tech_investmen.headline: Bangladesh Courts Silicon Valley CEOs for Tech Investment and Partnerships
bangladesh_silicon_valley_tech_investmen.summary: Bangladesh’s senior ministerial team met Silicon Valley leaders in California to discuss AI, cybersecurity, semiconductor manufacturing and digital infrastructure investment opportunities.
highlights: Finance and Planning Adviser Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir led the delegation alongside State Minister Shama Obaed Islam.
Silicon Valley CEOs including Replit founder Amjad Masad and Zscaler chairman Jay Chaudhry attended the roundtable.
Discussions targeted AI, cybersecurity, semiconductor design, digital infrastructure and venture‑capital pathways for Bangladesh.

bangladesh_south_korea_cepa_negotiations.headline: Bangladesh Invites South Korean President Lee Jae Myung for State Visit
bangladesh_south_korea_cepa_negotiations.summary: Bangladesh’s foreign minister Humaiun Kobir will travel to Seoul to deliver Tarique Rahman’s invitation for President Lee Jae Myung to visit, seeking to expand trade under CEPA.
highlights: State Minister Humaiun Kobir will meet Korean Ambassador Kim Ji-joon before his Seoul trip
Both countries aim to increase Korean investment in Bangladesh’s AI, shipbuilding and electronics sectors

japan_bangladesh_infrastructure_energy_c.headline: Japan‑Bangladesh Ties Deepen as President Meets Ambassador Shinichi
japan_bangladesh_infrastructure_energy_c.summary: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Japanese Ambassador Saida Shinichi discussed expanding cooperation in infrastructure, trade, energy, agriculture and vocational training.
highlights: Japan supports Bangladesh projects like Dhaka Metro Rail, Meghna Bridge, and the third terminal of Hazrat Shahjalal Airport.
President seeks increased Japanese investment in northern Bangladesh’s fruit, crop production and processing sectors.
Japan pledged assistance for energy security and Rohingya repatriation.

india_25_bn_deep_tech_fund.headline: India Allocates $25 Billion to Accelerate Deep‑Tech Start‑Ups
india_25_bn_deep_tech_fund.summary: India’s government will commit $11 billion and match private capital to create a $25 billion pool aimed at boosting AI, semiconductor and space‑tech startups.
highlights: Government’s $11 billion pledge under the Research Development Infrastructure Fund will be matched by venture capital, targeting
Recent unicorns like Skyroot and Sarvam illustrate the sector’s rapid commercialization despite a funding gap versus the U.S.’s
Only 2 % of Indian investors can write checks over $10 million, highlighting the need for more high‑net‑worth capital.

china_humanoid_robot_ipo_criteria.headline: China Tightens Humanoid Robot IPO Rules, Few Startups Qualify
china_humanoid_robot_ipo_criteria.summary: The CSRC now demands sustainable revenue, narrowed losses and core tech for embodied AI firms, slashing the pool of eligible humanoid robot IPO candidates.
highlights: Applicants must show sustainable revenue and commercial orders under the new ‘window guidance’.
A three‑year loss‑reduction forecast is required, and firms need core technology like a robotic brain or hands.
Only a handful of the over 100 Chinese humanoid firms are expected to meet all three criteria.

oura_ipo_postponement.headline: Smart Ring Maker Oura Delays Nasdaq IPO Amid Market Uncertainty
oura_ipo_postponement.summary: Oura postponed its Nasdaq IPO, citing volatile market conditions despite strong demand and projected 90% revenue growth for fiscal 2026.
highlights: Oura planned to raise up to $2.2 billion by selling 50 million shares
The company remains profitable and expects 90% year‑over‑year revenue growth in 2026
Rising sovereign‑debt yields are prompting issuers to demand larger IPO discounts

stock_market_decline.headline: Dhaka Stock Exchange slides for fourth consecutive session
stock_market_decline.summary: The DSEX fell to 5,524 as market turnover dropped 15%, with investors cautious ahead of earnings from June‑closing companies.
highlights: DSEX slipped 1.5 points to 5,524, while the DSE Shariah Index and DS30 also declined
Market turnover fell 15% and only 142 of 395 stocks advanced
Textiles led turnover at 28.8%, but paper, IT and mutual funds posted the steepest declines

travel_ban_money_laundering.headline: ACC Moves to Ban Travel of Ex‑Minister Arafat and Wife
travel_ban_money_laundering.summary: The Anti‑Corruption Commission has applied to the court to prevent former information minister Mohammad Ali Arafat and his wife Sharmin Mushtari from leaving Bangladesh amid a money‑laundering probe.
highlights: ACC seeks court order to restrict overseas travel of Arafat and his wife
Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit previously froze their bank accounts in August 2024
International Crimes Tribunal sentenced Arafat to death in absentia on 15 September

beximco_board_approval.headline: BSEC Reconstitutes Beximco Pharma Board, Excluding Salman F Rahman
beximco_board_approval.summary: The regulator approved a new nine‑member board for Beximco Pharmaceuticals, removing vice‑chairman Salman F Rahman amid the group’s massive debt crisis.
highlights: The board includes three Beximco Group reps, one IFIC Bank nominee, four independents (one woman) and the managing director.
Beximco Group’s loans total about Tk50,098 crore, with Tk25,524 crore classified as defaulted.

pce_release.headline: Fed’s Core Inflation Gauge Expected to Remain Above Target
pce_release.summary: Wednesday’s PCE price index is projected to rise 0.3% month‑over‑month and 3.3%‑3.7% year‑over‑year, keeping inflation well above the Fed’s 2% goal.
highlights: Core PCE inflation expected at 0.3% monthly and 3.3% annually
Fed officials signal at least one more rate hike this year, with benchmark now at 3.75%-4%
Consumer spending rose 0.8% in August despite higher gasoline prices

record_buyback.headline: Nvidia launches $150 billion buyback as stock hits decade‑low P/E
record_buyback.summary: Nvidia announced an additional $150 billion share repurchase, citing a P/E of 14.5—the cheapest valuation in ten years despite soaring AI‑driven profits.
highlights: Authorized $150 billion on top of the earlier $80 billion program
Fiscal 2028 net income forecast near $385 billion, a 60% increase year‑over‑year
Share price rose about 2% after the announcement

europe_deal_proposal.headline: Dimon Proposes Grand US‑Europe Trade Deal to Boost Western Economy
europe_deal_proposal.summary: Jamie Dimon urges the United States to offer Europe a sweeping free‑trade pact if it enacts major economic and defence reforms, aiming to cement Western unity.
highlights: Dimon calls for Europe to complete its Capital Markets Union and Banking Union.
The proposed pact could extend to Canada, Mexico, Japan, South Korea, Australia and the Philippines.

private_sector_credit_growth_5.headline: Bangladesh Private Sector Credit Growth Stagnates Below 5% for Six Months
private_sector_credit_growth_5.summary: Private sector credit growth slowed to 4.75% in August, as weak demand, high inflation and energy costs keep borrowing expensive.
highlights: August credit growth recorded at 4.75%
Bankers cite weak investment demand and high interest rates as key constraints

world_energies_summit_offshore_terms.headline: Bangladesh Offers Competitive Offshore PSC Terms to Attract Global Oil Firms
world_energies_summit_offshore_terms.summary: Bangladesh invited international oil and gas companies to bid on 26 offshore blocks, emphasizing the 2026 PSC model and untapped Bay of Bengal resources.
highlights: The bidding round includes 11 shallow‑water and 15 deep‑water blocks.
State Minister Anindya Islam Amit stressed rising domestic energy demand driven by rapid economic growth.

uk_investors_urged_to_invest_in_banglade.headline: Bangladesh Tourism Minister Calls on UK Investors to Boost Hospitality Sector
uk_investors_urged_to_invest_in_banglade.summary: Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat pledged a secure, favourable environment for British investors to develop Bangladesh’s natural attractions into a competitive tourism and hospitality industry.
highlights: The UK Department for Transport gave Osmani International Airport a 98% safety score and Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport
The European Union has classified Bangladesh cargo as “High Risk” since 2017, prompting calls for its removal.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is prioritising foreign direct investment to diversify the economy.

ai_resume_disruption.headline: AI Overhauls Hiring: Skills‑Based Selection Replaces Traditional Resumes
ai_resume_disruption.summary: Employers are shifting to AI‑driven, skills‑focused hiring as resume overload and bias make traditional applications ineffective for modern workforces.
highlights: UK graduate employers received an average of 140 applications per vacancy in 2025, the highest level in three decades
Around two‑thirds of UK organisations have adopted skills‑based hiring according to 2026 Michael Page research
PMG assesses candidates through practical exercises, team projects and client briefs to gauge real‑world skills

prediction_market_job_growth.headline: Prediction Markets Bet U.S. September Job Gains Exceed Economist Forecast
prediction_market_job_growth.summary: Traders on Kalshi and Polymarket assign roughly a 60% chance that September added over 90,000 jobs, outpacing the 84,000 forecast.
highlights: August added 162,000 jobs, surprising expectations
Federal Reserve may use stronger labor data to justify further rate hikes
ADP will release its own employment estimate on Wednesday before the official report

furnace_oil_price_increase_to_tk108_78_p.headline: Bangladesh Raises Furnace Oil Price to Tk108.78 Amid Global Volatility
furnace_oil_price_increase_to_tk108_78_p.summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission increased furnace oil to Tk108.78 per litre, an 8.36% rise, reflecting higher international crude and Brent prices.
highlights: BERC’s new rate applies to Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation supplies for power plants and industrial users
The price is based on average Platts furnace‑oil rates and September FOB crude prices
Brent crude rose from $89.64 to $114.26 per barrel in early September before settling at $102.59

probe_into_artificial_lpg_shortages_and_.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
probe_into_artificial_lpg_shortages_and_.headline: Bangladesh Minister Orders Probe into Artificial LPG Shortages and Overpricing
probe_into_artificial_lpg_shortages_and_.summary: The Energy Minister instructed district officials to investigate alleged artificial LPG shortages and ensure prices do not exceed the rate set by the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission.
highlights: Deputy commissioners must submit evidence on why reported shortages exist despite adequate supply.
Government will meet importers and take action against entities creating artificial shortages or overcharging.
Steps will be taken to increase LPG supply in affected areas.

seeks_direct_t_rkiye_flights_from_chatto.headline: Bangladesh Minister Urges Direct Flights from Chattogram and Sylhet to Türkiye
seeks_direct_t_rkiye_flights_from_chatto.summary: Civil Aviation Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat appealed to Turkey to launch direct routes from Chattogram’s Shah Amanat and Sylhet’s Osmani airports, citing growing expatriate travel demand.
highlights: Turkish Airlines is considering adding three weekly flights to its existing Dhaka‑Istanbul service.
Opening of the Third Terminal at Hazrat Shahjalal Airport will support expanded international operations.

core_inflation_august.headline: Fed’s Preferred Gauge Shows Core Inflation at 3% in August, Below Expectations
core_inflation_august.summary: August’s personal consumption expenditures price index rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, putting annual core inflation at 3%, easing expectations for an October rate hike.
highlights: Core inflation eased to 3% versus the forecasted 3.3%.
Revised BEA methodology trimmed price measures for legal services, software, and portfolio management.
Traders pushed the next likely Fed rate increase from October to December.

private_jobs_sept.headline: ADP Reports Private Sector Adds 90,000 Jobs in September
private_jobs_sept.summary: Private sector employment rose by 90,000 in September, outpacing forecasts and signaling continued labor market stability as base pay grew 3.2% year‑over‑year.
highlights: Service providers added 59,000 jobs while goods producers contributed 31,000
Education and health services led hiring with 55,000 new positions
Northeast region accounted for 56,000 of the total gains

factory_activity_sept_growth.headline: China factory activity ends two‑month contraction, PMI rises to 50.1
factory_activity_sept_growth.summary: China's manufacturing PMI rebounded to 50.1 in September, driven by equipment, high‑tech output and a modest rise in services activity.
highlights: Manufacturing PMI climbed to 50.1, ending a two‑month decline
Non‑manufacturing PMI reached 50.2, its highest level this year
Beijing announced mortgage subsidies and expanded credit support for infrastructure

potential_500m_fdi_bangladesh.headline: Plug and Play Targets Over $500 Million FDI for Bangladesh
potential_500m_fdi_bangladesh.summary: Bangladesh’s delegation met Silicon Valley’s Plug and Play to outline a strategy that could mobilise more than $500 million in foreign direct investment and foster AI and tech partnerships.
highlights: Plug and Play presented a proposal to channel over $500 million of potential FDI into Bangladesh’s tech sector
The agreement includes creating a Bangladesh Tech Center and an AI Centre of Excellence to link local startups with global
Key focus areas span ICT, AI, consumer electronics, light engineering, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and

dhaka_sylhet_highway_land_acquisition.headline: Land Acquisition Hurdles for Dhaka‑Sylhet Six‑Lane Highway to Clear by October
dhaka_sylhet_highway_land_acquisition.summary: Minister Khandaker Abdul Muktadir said most of the 113 land acquisition cases will be settled by October, aiming to finish the Sylhet section by 2028.
highlights: The highway is slated for full completion between late 2028 and mid‑2029.
Inspection teams included Sylhet WASA Chairman Miftah Siddiqui and Additional Deputy Commissioner Pinky Saha.

fleet_expansion_geopolitics.headline: Biman’s Multi‑Billion Dollar Fleet Expansion Faces Pilot Shortage and Debt Risks
fleet_expansion_geopolitics.summary: Bangladesh’s flag carrier plans to add 35 aircraft by 2035 despite a 28% pilot deficit and over Tk7,075 crore in state liabilities, raising doubts over operational feasibility.
highlights: Biman aims to grow its fleet to 54 aircraft by 2035, exceeding the government target of 47.
The airline owes more than Tk7,075 crore to state entities, including Tk5,842 crore to CAAB.
A 28% pilot shortage means 61 pilots are currently missing, limiting flight frequencies.

cnbc.com/2026/09/30/wall-streets-strong-.headline: Wall Street Closes Q3 Strong Amid AI Surge and Lilly’s Mixed Obesity Trial
cnbc.com/2026/09/30/wall-streets-strong-.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted modest gains for September, driven by AI‑related stocks, while Eli Lilly’s new obesity drug combo delivered higher weight loss but raised safety concerns.
highlights: S&P 500 up about 2.6% YTD and Nasdaq up 3% over the past three months
Top AI performers were Intel, Meta Platforms, and CrowdStrike; laggards included FedEx Freight and Home Depot
Lilly’s EloraTZP combo achieved 23.3% weight loss versus 14.8% for tirzepatide alone, but showed more adverse events during dose

cnbc.com/2026/09/30/treasury-yields-bond.headline: 10‑Year Treasury Yield Rises Amid Soft Inflation and Jobs Outlook
cnbc.com/2026/09/30/treasury-yields-bond.summary: U.S. Treasury yields edged higher as August inflation cooled, while markets shifted expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes ahead of Friday’s jobs report.
highlights: 10‑year yield rose to 5.293%, near 2007 highs.
Core PCE inflation eased to 3% year‑over‑year, below forecasts.
FedWatch odds for an October rate hike fell from over 80% to about 37%.

cnbc.com/2026/09/30/iran-war-strait-horm.headline: Hormuz Crude Exports Reach Prewar Levels While Refined Fuel Remains Tight
cnbc.com/2026/09/30/iran-war-strait-horm.summary: Crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to pre‑war volumes, but refined product flows stay far below historic levels, tightening global fuel markets.
highlights: Crude transit averaged 13.5 million barrels per day, matching the pre‑war baseline
Refined product shipments through Hormuz are only 677,000 bpd, far below the 3.6 million bpd pre‑war level
About 40% of Gulf crude now bypasses Hormuz via pipelines, up from 17% before the war

adani_coal_shortage_cuts_power_supply_to.institution: Bangladesh Power Development Board / Adani Power
adani_coal_shortage_cuts_power_supply_to.headline: Adani Coal Shortage Slashes Power Supply to Bangladesh to 500‑600 MW
adani_coal_shortage_cuts_power_supply_to.summary: A coal shortage and the outage of Unit‑1 at Adani’s Godda plant have cut Bangladesh’s imports to roughly 500‑600 MW, heightening grid stress.
highlights: Supply fell to 504 MW on 1 Oct after Unit‑1 tripped
Load shedding exceeded 2,000 MW on 29‑30 Sept

launch_of_bangla_qr_secure_digital_payme.headline: Finance Minister Declares Bangla QR a Secure, Fraud‑Free Digital Payment Platform
launch_of_bangla_qr_secure_digital_payme.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury said Bangla QR offers encrypted, charge‑free transactions that deposit directly into any bank account, aiming to reduce cash use.
highlights: Transactions via Bangla QR are free of charge regardless of the bank
The system enables direct account deposits using QR codes
Initial rollout may face technical glitches, but issues are expected to be resolved

extension_of_transition_period_for_fully.headline: Chattogram Port Extends Transition for Online Container Bill Payments
extension_of_transition_period_for_fully.summary: The port authority will accept traditional pay orders and revolving accounts until 31 October, after which all container bills must be paid online via banking channels.
highlights: Extension granted until 31 October after request from Chattogram Customs Agents Association
Online payments will be processed through Sonali Bank’s gateway after system integration
Pay orders and revolving accounts cease from 1 November

south_korea_alaska_lng_project.headline: South Korea Delays Alaska LNG Participation Amid Commercial Concerns
south_korea_alaska_lng_project.summary: President Lee Jae Myung said South Korea’s involvement in the $50 billion Alaska LNG project hinges on financial viability and legal compliance, despite Trump’s claims.
highlights: Lee emphasized that participation depends on commercial reasonableness and cash‑flow prospects
The Texas natural‑gas power plant, valued at $22.3 billion, targets operation by 2029
Industry Minister Kim Jung‑kwan labeled the Alaska LNG project high‑risk due to upfront costs

kashkari_inflation_still_high.headline: Fed's Kashkari Warns Inflation Remains High Despite Cooler PCE Data
kashkari_inflation_still_high.summary: Fed President Neel Kashkari said inflation stays around 3% and remains too high even as core PCE eases and the labor market stays fairly strong.
highlights: Core PCE inflation eased to 3% year‑over‑year, below forecasts.
The Fed raised its neutral funds rate estimate to 3.25% amid AI‑driven investment demand.
ADP reported private payroll growth exceeding expectations, supporting a “pretty good” labor market.

boeing_navy_fighter_jet_contract.headline: Boeing Gains 3% After Winning $20 Billion U.S. Navy Sixth‑Generation Fighter Contract
boeing_navy_fighter_jet_contract.summary: Boeing's shares rose as it secured a more‑than $20 billion Pentagon contract to develop the Sixth‑Generation F/A‑XX fighter, while rival Northrop fell.
highlights: The F/A‑XX will replace the U.S. Navy's F/A‑18 Super Hornets.
The deal is Boeing's second sixth‑generation jet win in two years, after the Air Force selected its F‑47 fighter.

oct_fuel_price_freeze.headline: Bangladesh freezes October fuel prices amid September hike fallout
oct_fuel_price_freeze.summary: A Tk 20‑per‑litre increase in September raised diesel, octane, petrol and kerosene prices, pushing transport costs and food prices higher despite an October freeze.
highlights: Truck and pickup fares jumped Tk 2,000‑5,000 per trip after the hike
Eggs now sell for Tk 160‑170 per dozen, up from Tk 120 earlier September

bd_sk_trade_expansion.headline: Bangladesh Pushes for Expanded Trade and Investment with South Korea
bd_sk_trade_expansion.summary: State Minister Humaiun Kobir urged greater market access for Bangladeshi products and increased Korean investment, citing the new CEPA and upcoming presidential visit.
highlights: Korea and Bangladesh aim to finalize the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) soon.
Bangladesh seeks Korean support for its accession to the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP).
KOICA’s US$39 million Saemaul Plus programme is slated for expansion into digital health and AI projects.

admin_hurdles_easing.headline: Bangladesh Commerce Minister Calls for Cutting Administrative Hurdles to Boost Investment
admin_hurdles_easing.summary: Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir urged faster, simpler business registration and approval processes, emphasizing digital integration to attract both domestic and foreign investors.
highlights: Reduce unnecessary steps in business registration and approvals
Strengthen coordination among RJSC, Invest Bangladesh Authority and other agencies
Move services to integrated digital platforms for greater transparency

private_market_exam_proposal.headline: SEC Mulls Investor Exam to Broaden Access to Private Markets
private_market_exam_proposal.summary: The SEC proposes a 75‑question exam, allowing anyone 18 or older to qualify as an accredited investor without meeting traditional income or net‑worth thresholds.
highlights: Current accredited investor criteria require $200,000 annual income or $1 million net worth.
FINRA would develop the exam, modeled after its existing securities professional test and costing about $100.
Test results would be valid for ten years before the investor must retake the exam.

ukraine_energy_grid_strikes.headline: Russia Launches Massive Strikes on Ukraine’s Power Grid Ahead of Winter
ukraine_energy_grid_strikes.summary: Russia’s coordinated air and drone attacks crippled Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, prompting emergency cuts in Kyiv as freezing temperatures loom and the winter energy crisis deepens.
highlights: Seven civilians were killed in the attacks
Ukrenergo imposed emergency power cuts in Kyiv and three other regions
Russia used ground‑based high‑precision weapons and attack drones

global_tariffs_forced_labour.headline: Trump's Global Tariffs Face New Challenge in Trade Court
global_tariffs_forced_labour.summary: A panel of judges at the U.S. Court of International Trade is reviewing lawsuits alleging that the Section 301 tariffs on 86 countries are a pretext for protectionism.
highlights: The tariffs impose 10% or 12.5% duties on goods covering 99.4% of U.S. imports.
Plaintiffs argue the administration lacked country‑specific findings required by the statute.

dominage_steel_share_transfer_directive.headline: BSEC Orders DSE to Finalize Dominage Steel Share Transfer in Seven Days
dominage_steel_share_transfer_directive.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission directed the Dhaka Stock Exchange to complete the transfer of 30.78 lakh Dominage Steel shares to new owners within a week.
highlights: Transfer involves 30.78 lakh shares (~30% of Dominage Steel) to Akij Resources, Sheikh Jasim Uddin and Faria Hossain
Shares remain under lock‑in and prohibitory rules, but BSEC approved the off‑market negotiated transaction
Dominage Steel reported a 54% revenue drop and a net loss in FY2025‑26

dsex_index_decline_19_pts.headline: Selling Pressure Pulls DSEX Down 19 Points Amid Earnings Uncertainty
dsex_index_decline_19_pts.summary: The DSE benchmark index slipped 0.34% to 5,531.65 as investors remained cautious over weaker corporate earnings and a lack of conviction in the recovery.
highlights: DSEX fell 18.79 points, while the DS30 dropped 4.86 points
Turnover rose 3.4% to Tk720 crore despite the decline
Non‑bank financial institutions led sector losses, down 1.20%

vat_return_deadline_extension.headline: NBR Extends July‑August VAT Return Deadline to 15 October
vat_return_deadline_extension.summary: The National Board of Revenue has pushed the filing deadline for July and August VAT returns to 15 October, assuring businesses no penalties for late submissions.
highlights: The extension applies to both July and August VAT returns.
No fines will be imposed for submissions made by 15 October.
The change follows a recent reversal to monthly filing after a quarterly pilot.

operation_economic_outcast_targets_iran_.headline: US Treasury sanctions Iran’s auto and rail sectors in latest strike
operation_economic_outcast_targets_iran_.summary: The Treasury announced new sanctions targeting Iran’s automotive and rail industries, as well as foreign suppliers, aiming to cut revenue streams for the regime.
highlights: Iran’s automotive sector is linked to the Revolutionary Guard and labeled a lucrative cash cow despite $1 billion annual losses
Foreign parts exporters from the UAE, Hong Kong, Indonesia and Turkey are also designated
The A7 Network, a shadow banking system tied to Russia, faces additional sanctions

chinese_refiners_suspend_october_fuel_ex.headline: Oil Prices Surge as US Deploys Carrier Group and Chinese Refineries Halt Exports
chinese_refiners_suspend_october_fuel_ex.summary: Brent crude jumped 4.4% to $102.31 per barrel amid US carrier deployment to the Middle East and Chinese refiners cancelling October fuel exports.
highlights: Brent crude closed at $102.31 per barrel, up 4.4%.
U.S. sent the USS Theodore Roosevelt and announced a third carrier strike group to the region.
Chinese refiners cancelled planned gasoline and jet fuel exports for October.

gm_q3_sales_down_5_5_amid_ev_slump.headline: GM sales tumble 5.5% as Toyota surges with EVs and hybrids
gm_q3_sales_down_5_5_amid_ev_slump.summary: General Motors reported a 5.5% year‑over‑year sales decline, while Toyota’s electrified models boosted its sales, narrowing the gap with the U.S. leader.
highlights: GM’s EV models fell sharply, with the Equinox EV down 92.4% and the Blazer EV down 84.4%.
Toyota’s EV and hybrid sales accounted for over 57% of its quarterly volume, up 28.5% year‑over‑year.
Chevrolet’s low‑cost models like the Trailblazer rose 51%, offsetting declines in higher‑priced lines.

banklawreformsoftening.headline: Bangladesh Finance Ministry Softens Bank Governance Reforms, Keeps Family Board Limit
banklawreformsoftening.summary: The ministry reduced director tenure to nine years but retained the three‑member family cap, easing several stricter proposals amid concerns over bank governance.
highlights: Proposed cuts to family directors from three to two and tenure from 12 to six years were rejected.
Rules on directors with defaulted loans and Bangladesh Bank's power to dissolve boards were also softened.

newmooringterminalplan.headline: Chattogram Port Committee Demands Transparency on 15‑Year NCT Concession
newmooringterminalplan.summary: The committee warned that handing over the New Mooring Container Terminal to a foreign operator for 15 years could jeopardize revenue, jobs and national security without full disclosure.
highlights: Cabinet approved the draft concession under the miscellaneous agenda of the Economic Affairs committee.
Committee calls for public release of the agreement, financial structure, and independent revenue impact assessment.

lpgcargoprobe.headline: Bangladesh LPG Traders Demand Probe Over Alleged Cargo Hoarding Amid Price Spike
lpgcargoprobe.summary: LOAB members allege major importers withheld September LPG shipments, prompting a government audit as retail cylinder prices soar above the BERC‑fixed rate.
highlights: September LPG imports were about 158,000 tonnes, virtually unchanged from August.
Retail price of a 12 kg cylinder rose above Tk 2,000, far above the BERC‑set Tk 1,585.
LOAB named Aygaz, Omera, Petromax, BM Energy and Jamuna as importers to be audited.

india_trade_deal_status.headline: U.S. Trade Rep Greer Says India Deal Not Imminent After Trump‑Modi Call
india_trade_deal_status.summary: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer warned that a bilateral trade agreement with India remains distant despite a constructive Trump‑Modi phone call and ongoing negotiations.
highlights: Greer said no imminent deal, identifying sticking‑point items.
India faces possible 100% tariffs over its Russian oil purchases.
Current U.S. tariff on Indian exports is 10%, with exemptions for pharma and smartphones.

brazil_election.headline: Brazil Election Stakes Rise Amid U.S.-China Rivalry and Growing Debt
brazil_election.summary: Brazil's presidential vote this Sunday could reshape regional geopolitics, affect critical mineral access, and determine how the nation tackles its soaring debt burden.
highlights: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are dead‑locked in first‑round polls, with a runoff scheduled for Oct. 25 if no candidate exceeds 50%.
Brazil’s debt equals 82.9% of GDP and its budget deficit stands at 9.48% of GDP.
The country holds the world’s second‑largest rare‑earth reserves, making it a focal point in the U.S.–China strategic competition.

crypto_custody_rules.headline: SEC Pushes New Crypto Custody Rules as Congress Stalls Bill
crypto_custody_rules.summary: The SEC proposed a tailored framework allowing advisers and regulated funds to hold crypto assets, aiming to modernize custody rules while broader legislation remains stalled.
highlights: Proposed rules permit self‑custody of crypto assets under certain conditions
State trust companies could act as custodians for client crypto holdings
Public comment period lasts 60 days after publication in the Federal Register

bangladesh_seeks_south_korean_investment.headline: Bangladesh Seeks South Korean Investment and Expanded Defence Cooperation
bangladesh_seeks_south_korean_investment.summary: Bangladesh's foreign affairs minister urged South Korea to invest in a new defence industrial zone and deepen collaboration on training, peacekeeping and trade.
highlights: Agreement in principle reached on a Bangladesh‑South Korea CEPA
Bangladesh aims to attract South Korean investment in semiconductors, shipbuilding, ICT and high‑end garments
Both sides pledged to expand military training and UN peacekeeping cooperation

icb_seeks_tk10_000cr_rescue_fund_to_boos.headline: Finance Minister urges ICB professionalism as it seeks Tk10,000 cr rescue fund
icb_seeks_tk10_000cr_rescue_fund_to_boos.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury called for the state‑owned ICB to adopt market‑oriented, digital practices while requesting a Tk10,000 crore low‑cost fund to restructure its capital.
highlights: ICB carries about Tk14,000 crore in high‑interest borrowings.
Government has already provided Tk4,000 crore, partly used to repay debt and invest in the stock market.
BSEC aims to cut direct‑listing timeline from 18 months to three months.

launch_of_gpay_platform_targeting_youth_.headline: Yunus launches gpay to empower youth and boost entrepreneurship
launch_of_gpay_platform_targeting_youth_.summary: Professor Muhammad Yunus unveiled gpay, a cash‑less digital platform that will reinvest all revenue into social business education and youth entrepreneurship across Bangladesh.
highlights: gpay’s income will be fully allocated to the social business sector, not to investors
The platform will support the upcoming Grameen University to train young entrepreneurs and offer a secure digital wallet service
Grameen Bank’s micro‑credit model now operates in 32 US states, providing $35 billion in loans annually with a near‑100%

cnbc.com/2026/10/02/jobs-report-septembe.headline: U.S. September Jobs Growth Slows, Unemployment Rises to 4.2%
cnbc.com/2026/10/02/jobs-report-septembe.summary: September added just 29,000 jobs while the unemployment rate ticked up to 4.2%, prompting markets to bet the Fed will hold rates steady.
highlights: Nonfarm payrolls rose only 29,000, far below expectations of 84,000.
FedWatch odds rose to 82.8% that the Federal Reserve will keep rates unchanged at its October meeting.
Average hourly earnings grew 0.1% in September, keeping 12‑month wage growth at a 5‑year low.

cnbc.com/2026/10/02/ford-q3-sales.html.headline: Ford Holds onto No. 3 U.S. Sales Spot, Narrowly Beats Hyundai in Q3
cnbc.com/2026/10/02/ford-q3-sales.html.summary: Ford posted a 6.6% YoY drop to 507,395 vehicles, keeping its third‑place U.S. market rank as Hyundai logged a 5.4% rise to 506,200.
highlights: Ford’s light‑duty sales fell 6.6% year‑over‑year to 507,395 units.
Hyundai’s combined brands grew 5.4% to 506,200 units, nearly matching Ford.
Supplier fires disrupted Ford’s F‑Series pickup production, affecting overall sales.

cnbc.com/2026/10/02/jim-cramers-top-10-t.headline: Cramer Highlights AI Chip Investments, Earnings Beats and Labor Wins Ahead of Fed Decision
cnbc.com/2026/10/02/jim-cramers-top-10-t.summary: Jim Cramer points to soaring stock futures, Nvidia’s AI resurgence, Boeing’s union deal, and strong earnings from Accenture as the Fed nears its rate decision.
highlights: Brent crude slipped below $100 as diesel and crude stockpiles were released.
Nike shares fell 8% after missing revenue forecasts and cutting its fiscal 2027 outlook.
Toshiba plans to invest $380 million to double AI HDD production in the Philippines.

price_spike_oct2026.headline: Bangladesh Food Prices Surge as Sugar and Oil Supplies Tighten
price_spike_oct2026.summary: Consumers in Dhaka face rising costs for eggs, chicken, vegetables and fish as packaged sugar and soybean oil become scarce and sell above the government‑fixed rates.
highlights: Packaged sugar is selling for Tk120 per kg, above the Tk110 MRP, while soybean oil trades at Tk210 per litre, exceeding its
Eggs and broiler chicken prices have risen to Tk155‑160 per dozen and Tk180‑190 per kg respectively, driven by higher feed

bond_warehouses_sealed_oct2026.headline: Four Toss Bond Warehouses Sealed Over Unauthorized Duty‑Free Storage
bond_warehouses_sealed_oct2026.summary: Authorities sealed all four Toss Bond warehouses in South Gulshan after discovering liquor and other duty‑free goods stored in two unauthorized facilities.
highlights: CIID, Department of Narcotics Control and Special Response Battalion-1 jointly carried out the inspection
Toss Bond was authorized for only two warehouses but operated four

brick_kilns_removal_oct2026.headline: Bangladesh High Court orders removal of illegal brick kilns in Lakshmipur
brick_kilns_removal_oct2026.summary: The High Court has directed authorities to explain why they should not be ordered to dismantle all unauthorized brick kilns in Ramgati and Kamalnagar and halt new constructions.
highlights: A special bench of Justices Razik-Al-Jalil and Debasish Roy Chowdhury issued the rule after a writ petition was filed.
Fifteen senior officials from environment, energy, land and local government bodies were named as respondents.
The petitioner invoked Article 102 of the Constitution to demand the removal of illegal kilns and a ban on future establishments.

diesel_release.headline: G7 to Release 100 Million Barrels of Diesel Amid Global Supply Crunch
diesel_release.summary: The G7 agreed to deploy 100 million barrels of diesel over four months, coordinated by the IEA, to curb soaring prices caused by Ukraine and Iran conflicts.
highlights: Release will be front‑loaded, with a substantial portion delivered within the first 20 days.
U.S. diesel prices average $6.37 per gallon, near record highs.
G7 members pledged to avoid export restrictions on energy products.

rate_hike_odds_drop.headline: Traders See Slim Odds of Fed Rate Hike After Weak Jobs Report
rate_hike_odds_drop.summary: A soft September jobs report and cooler PCE inflation have cut the market’s estimate of a Fed rate increase in October to roughly 17%.
highlights: September added only 29,000 jobs, far below the 80,000‑plus forecast.
FedWatch shows a 17% chance of an October hike, down from 36% a week earlier.

layoffs_weak_outlook.headline: Nike shares tumble as revenue falls and layoffs loom
layoffs_weak_outlook.summary: Nike reported a 4% revenue drop to $11.2 billion, forecast high‑single‑digit declines for 2027, and announced a $2.5 billion cost‑saving layoff plan.
highlights: Revenue fell 4% to $11.2 billion, driven by weaker Greater China sales
Nike aims to cut $2.5 billion in costs by 2031 under the new "Pace" operating model
Shares have slid about 45% year‑to‑date

pm_calls_for_deeper_regional_cooperation.headline: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman Calls for Deeper Bay of Bengal Cooperation
pm_calls_for_deeper_regional_cooperation.summary: At the Bay of Bengal Conversation 2026, Bangladesh's leader urged regional partners to boost trade, energy, technology and climate initiatives for shared prosperity.
highlights: Bangladesh aims to dig 20,000 km of canals and plant 250 million trees within five years
The government plans to employ 100,000 healthcare workers, predominantly women, to expand community health services
Rohingya repatriation to Myanmar requires sustained global political and financial support

new_energy_roadmap_targets_local_coal_ga.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
new_energy_roadmap_targets_local_coal_ga.headline: Bangladesh Targets 12,940MW New Capacity with Solar and Coal
new_energy_roadmap_targets_local_coal_ga.summary: The government’s medium‑term roadmap adds 12,940 MW by 2030, chiefly 10,000 MW solar and 2,940 MW coal, to meet rising demand.
highlights: Solar projects will use PPP models in Sirajganj, Sonagazi and Rampal
World Bank approved a $350 million loan to support the solar rollout
Renewables aim to supply at least 30% of generation by 2040

uranium_fuel_convoy_dispatched_to_rooppu.institution: Bangladesh Atomic Energy Commission / Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
uranium_fuel_convoy_dispatched_to_rooppu.headline: Uranium Fuel Departs Dhaka for Rooppur Nuclear Plant Under Army Guard
uranium_fuel_convoy_dispatched_to_rooppu.summary: Three lorries carrying uranium fuel for Rooppur’s first unit left Dhaka airport this morning, escorted by the army, police and intelligence agencies.
highlights: The cargo flight arrived at 11:43 pm after a delay caused by Pakistan denying airspace.
The plant, built with Russian assistance, will generate 2,400 MW using VVER‑1200 reactors.

oil_prices_fall_on_report_of_potential_d.headline: Oil Prices Slip as G7 Releases Diesel and Crude Stocks
oil_prices_fall_on_report_of_potential_d.summary: Crude prices fell modestly after the G7 announced a 100 million‑barrel stock release, while Middle‑East tensions keep markets uneasy.
highlights: Brent crude closed at $102.25 per barrel
U.S. West Texas Intermediate settled at $91.11 per barrel
G7 will deploy 100 million barrels of reserves over the next four months, front‑loading diesel release in the first 20 days

anthropic_to_invest_100_million_to_train.headline: Anthropic Commits $100 Million to Train 10,000 AI Engineers
anthropic_to_invest_100_million_to_train.summary: Anthropic will fund the Claude Frontier Academy with $100 million to certify 10,000 frontier‑deployed engineers from its partner network by 2027.
highlights: Program includes engineers from Accenture, Morgan Stanley, Novo Nordisk and leading consulting firms
Anthropic aims for a $2 trillion market cap and reported $4.6 billion revenue with an $8 billion operating loss last year

cerebras_stock_hits_post_ipo_low_tumblin.headline: Cerebras shares tumble 20% as Nvidia wins OpenAI contract and lockup expires
cerebras_stock_hits_post_ipo_low_tumblin.summary: Cerebras stock fell nearly 20% this week after Nvidia was chosen for OpenAI's new model and a large insider lockup expired.
highlights: The share price closed Friday at $166.43, down from its IPO peak of a $95 billion market cap.
Up to 19.4 million insider shares, representing about 8% of the float, became tradable this week.
Cerebras' ASIC-based AI cloud service was originally backed by a $10 billion deal with OpenAI through 2028.

how_many_container_terminals_does_chatto.headline: Chattogram Port Operates Four Container Facilities, Laldia Terminal Under Development
how_many_container_terminals_does_chatto.summary: In 2025 the port handled containers through NCT, CCT, GCB and PCT, while the upcoming Laldia Terminal aims to boost capacity by 23%.
highlights: NCT alone accounted for 44% of total container volume in 2025.
RSGT operates PCT under a 22‑year concession and is slated to run CCT.
LCT concession with APM Terminals involves a $550 million investment for a 30‑year PPP.

9_containers_of_hazardous_chemicals_bein.headline: Nine Hazardous Chemical Containers Removed from Chattogram Port for Safe Destruction
9_containers_of_hazardous_chemicals_bein.summary: Nine containers holding 150.89 tonnes of expired sulphuric acid, nitric acid, methanol and thinner were dispatched from Chattogram port to Narayanganj for environmentally compliant destruction.
highlights: The operation was coordinated by Customs House and the Bangladesh National Authority for Chemical Weapons Convention.
Multiple agencies including Port Authority, Police, Fire Service and Border Guard assisted the removal.

ctg_port_protection_committee_demands_ca.headline: Chattogram Port Committee Demands Cancellation of NCT and CCT Concession Plans
ctg_port_protection_committee_demands_ca.summary: Labor unions at Chattogram port staged a sit‑in demanding the government scrap the 15‑year concession for the New Mooring Container Terminal and halt lease of the Container Terminal.
highlights: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs gave in‑principle approval to a 15‑year concession for NCT and OCY.
The committee seeks a national dialogue and a review of the 22‑year Red Sea Gateway Terminal agreement.

us_push_excess_industrial_capacity.headline: G20 Trade Ministers Split Over U.S. Push to curb Excess Capacity
us_push_excess_industrial_capacity.summary: A handful of G20 members rebuffed the U.S. demand for coordinated action on excess industrial capacity, highlighting deep divisions on trade policy.
highlights: Only Mexico and Argentina signed the U.S.-led statement on forced‑labor goods
China objected to the excess‑capacity language, echoing earlier G20 finance meetings

etf_strategy_tax_crackdown.headline: Treasury and IRS Crack Down on Wealthy ETF Tax‑Deferral Schemes
etf_strategy_tax_crackdown.summary: New Treasury guidance and an IRS revenue ruling target Section 351 ETF conversions used by high‑net‑worth investors to defer capital gains, signaling tighter enforcement.
highlights: IRS revenue ruling declares Section 351 ETF conversions that avoid tax “do not work” under current law.
Treasury warns that $22 billion of ETF structures created since 2024 may be abusive, prompting comment period ending Oct 28.
Valid Section 351 exchanges remain permissible if the ETF retains the contributed assets and meets portfolio concentration limits.

china_deal_spree_7_8bn.headline: Big Pharma accelerates China tie‑ups with Novartis $7.8 billion licensing deal
china_deal_spree_7_8bn.summary: Novartis signed a licensing agreement with Abogen Biosciences worth up to $7.8 billion, reflecting Western drugmakers’ push into China amid looming patent cliffs.
highlights: Novartis will pay $575 million upfront and up to $7.2 billion in milestones for global rights to Abogen’s mRNA therapy.
Licensing deals let Western firms access Chinese biotech innovations while limiting risk, as China’s NMPA reforms speed clinical

worldbank_bd_energy_financing_delegation.headline: World Bank Delegation Discusses Energy Financing and Infrastructure Reforms in Bangladesh
worldbank_bd_energy_financing_delegation.summary: A four‑member World Bank team will meet Bangladeshi ministries to address high LNG import costs, fuel financing, renewable energy expansion, and key transport corridor investments.
highlights: World Bank’s LNG financing to Bangladesh totals $700 million
Discussions include Bay Terminal and Dhaka‑Chattogram Logistics Corridor projects

lpg_supply_crisis_meeting.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
lpg_supply_crisis_meeting.headline: Bangladesh Energy Minister Tackles LPG Supply Crisis and Price Surge
lpg_supply_crisis_meeting.summary: Minister Iqbal Hassan Mahmood met LPG importers and commerce minister to address shortages and allegations of overpricing despite government‑set cylinder rates.
highlights: Government fixed price for a 12kg LPG cylinder at Tk1,585 for September
Import volumes reported between 120,000‑160,000 tonnes, with importers citing shipping disruptions
Energy minister ordered district commissioners to investigate artificial shortages and enforce price controls

bonded_yarn_seizure_nbr_action.headline: BTMA Demands Legal Action After Bonded Yarn Seized in Bangladesh
bonded_yarn_seizure_nbr_action.summary: BTMA says over 500 cartons of 80‑count yarn imported duty‑free from China and India were seized, alleging misuse of bonded warehouse exemptions.
highlights: More than 500 cartons of 80‑count yarn were confiscated from warehouses in Araihazar and Madhabdi.
BTMA alleges the yarn was diverted for domestic sale, breaching bonded‑warehouse rules.

brazil_election_2026_10_03.headline: Wall Street Awaits Brazil Election Outcome, Markets Split on Lula vs Bolsonaro
brazil_election_2026_10_03.summary: Investors brace for divergent bond, currency and equity moves as Brazil's tight presidential race pits Lula's leftist agenda against Bolsonaro's promised fiscal discipline.
highlights: Bolsonaro's win could trigger rallies in Brazil's bonds, stocks and the USD/BRL currency pair
JPMorgan projects MSCI Brazil upside of up to 41% if a robust reform agenda is implemented

jobs_nvidia_micron_2026_10_03.headline: Jobs Report, AI Demand and Micron Outlook Propel Market Action
jobs_nvidia_micron_2026_10_03.summary: A softer‑than‑expected jobs report and strong AI‑related earnings from Nvidia and Micron lifted the Nasdaq, while oil price declines eased broader market pressure.
highlights: U.S. non‑farm payrolls added 29,000 jobs, unemployment rose to 4.2%, prompting a 78% chance the Fed will hold rates.
Nvidia authorized an extra $150 billion in share buybacks, boosting its cash‑return capacity.
Micron forecast FY2027 revenue of $61.5 billion and highlighted tight supply‑demand outlook despite a quarterly earnings dip.

lennar_stake_increase_2026_10_03.headline: Berkshire Increases Lennar Stake to 11.2% as Purchase Pace Slows
lennar_stake_increase_2026_10_03.summary: Berkshire Hathaway raised its holding in homebuilder Lennar to 11.2%, valuing the stake at $2.1 billion, while daily purchase amounts fell sharply.
highlights: Berkshire bought $53.6 million of Lennar Class A shares and $329,000 of super‑voting B shares this week.
Average daily purchase dropped from $58 million to under $18 million, indicating a slower buying pace.

rampal_power_plant_record_output.headline: Rampal Coal Plant Breaks Record with 1,321MW Generation
rampal_power_plant_record_output.summary: After a mechanical fault, Rampal’s two units resumed output, delivering a record 1,321 megawatts directly to Bangladesh’s national grid.
highlights: Unit 1 produced 656MW and Unit 2 produced 665MW, totaling 1,321MW.
The plant operates under the Bangladesh‑India Friendship Power Company Limited joint venture.
Generation exceeded the plant’s installed capacity of 1,320MW.

inflation_pressure_statement.headline: Inflation Erodes Purchasing Power as Bangladesh Prioritises Banking Confidence and Investment
inflation_pressure_statement.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury warned that rising inflation is squeezing household purchasing power while the government pushes banking confidence, investment and tax reforms.
highlights: Inflation is lowering purchasing power and hindering tax collection relative to GDP
The government aims to restore banking sector confidence and boost private investment amid global economic uncertainties
Geopolitical conflicts and climate change keep energy and transport costs volatile, affecting commodity prices

24_7_customs_clearance_proposal.headline: Bangladesh Pushes 24/7 Customs but Needs Full Supply Chain Support
24_7_customs_clearance_proposal.summary: Stakeholders warn that keeping customs open at ports will not speed clearance unless banks, shipping lines, freight forwarders and transport providers also operate round‑the‑clock.
highlights: Customs offices at major ports now operate round‑the‑clock to speed cargo processing
Stakeholders say banks, shipping lines, freight forwarders and transport must also work weekends and holidays
At Chattogram port, registering a bill of entry is only the first step before full clearance

50bn_share_buyback.headline: Salesforce Launches $50 Billion Share Buyback, Signals Growth Uncertainty
50bn_share_buyback.summary: Salesforce authorized a $50 billion repurchase, executing half quickly, highlighting abundant cash but unclear future growth amid AI-driven market shifts.
highlights: The buyback represents the largest accelerated share repurchase in corporate history.
Salesforce generated $17.73 billion levered free cash flow on $43.94 billion revenue, with a 21.38% operating margin.
The company’s debt stands at $42.38 billion against $11.4 billion cash.

auto_repair_costs_rise.headline: High‑Tech Vehicles Push Auto Repair Costs Up 60% Since 2019
auto_repair_costs_rise.summary: Advanced driver‑assistance systems and calibration equipment are forcing independent shops to spend thousands on software and hardware, driving repair prices up 60%.
highlights: Repair costs have risen about 60% from January 2019 to August 2026, nearly double the 32% overall inflation rate
A single calibration machine costs about $28,000, with a full array of equipment reaching up to $90,000
Independent shops must maintain multiple brand‑specific laptops and pay for recurring software subscriptions

betel_leaf_certificate_suspension.institution: Bangladesh High Court/Betel Leaves Exporters Association
betel_leaf_certificate_suspension.headline: Appellate Division Halts Mandatory Betel Leaf Export Certificate Requirement
betel_leaf_certificate_suspension.summary: The chamber court suspended the High Court ruling that forced exporters to obtain a Bangladesh Betel Leaves Exporters Association certificate, removing the current legal barrier.
highlights: The Appellate Division’s chamber court stayed the High Court order that made the association’s certificate mandatory for betel
The Ministry of Commerce, represented by Attorney General Md Ruhul Quddus Kajal, successfully challenged the certificate

lpg_price_increase.headline: Bangladesh Raises 12kg LPG Cylinder Price to Tk1,837
lpg_price_increase.summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission increased the 12kg LPG cylinder price by Tk252 to Tk1,837, citing higher Saudi contract costs and shipping fees.
highlights: BERC based the new price on Saudi Aramco contract prices of $680 for propane and $730 per tonne for butane, averaging $712.50
Consumer-level autogas price set at Tk84.62 per litre and reticulated LPG liquid price at Tk149.31 per kg for October.
Government‑supplied 12.5kg LPG cylinder price remains unchanged at Tk776.93 despite market hikes.

financial_sector_stability_statement.headline: Parliamentary Committee Calls for Transparency and Stability in Bangladesh Financial Sector
financial_sector_stability_statement.summary: The Finance Ministry’s standing committee urged greater transparency, accountability and economic stability for banks, demanding clearer data in its next parliamentary session.
highlights: Committee Chairman Mushfiqur Rahman led the meeting at Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban
Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury and senior officials from Bangladesh Bank attended
The committee instructed the ministry to present detailed financial institution data at the next meeting

ai_czar_appointment.headline: Trump Appoints DNI Jay Clayton as New AI Czar to Lead Super Intelligence Force
ai_czar_appointment.summary: President Trump named Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to head a 120‑day White House task force aimed at assessing AI risks and guiding federal policy.
highlights: The task force, called the “Super Intelligence Force,” will coordinate with consumers, critical infrastructure providers, and AI
Members include FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, Defense Department’s under secretary Emil Michael, and OPM director Scott Kupor.
Trump pledged not to hinder AI industry growth while seeking voluntary safety standards.

govt_plans_300m_fast_track_project_to_tu.headline: Bangladesh launches $300 million fast‑track plan to turn Chattogram Airport into regional hub
govt_plans_300m_fast_track_project_to_tu.summary: The government seeks Asian Development Bank financing to expand runway, terminals and cargo facilities, aiming to double cargo capacity and serve 8‑10 million passengers annually.
highlights: First phase targets $250 million public investment with $175 million sought from ADB.
